svg.title: GQA is the practical middle ground between MHA and MQA
svg.desc: Multi-Head Attention gives every query head its own key and value projection, producing the largest KV cache. Multi-Query Attention shares a single KV head across all query heads, the smallest cache but the most aggressive reduction. Grouped-Query Attention groups query heads to share one KV head per group — Llama 3 70B uses 64 query heads and 8 KV heads, an 8x reduction, and Llama 3.1 405B uses 128 query heads and 8 KV heads, a 16x reduction.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: GQA is the practical middle ground between MHA and MQA

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: MHA: every query head owns its K/V. MQA: all heads share one K/V head.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: GQA: groups of query heads share one K/V head — the practical middle ground.
